name: Pearl Drop
description: A delicate gold-tone cable chain necklace suspending a single lustrous freshwater pearl drop pendant.
materials: Fine gold-vermeil-look cable chain, genuine-look freshwater pearl drop
primaryColors: Warm gold with soft ivory pearl
negativeConstraints: Never render a second pearl, charm, gemstone, tag, or any text/engraving anywhere on the chain or clasp; never let the chain read as thick or chunky, it must stay fine and delicate at every angle. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the pearl's teardrop shape, size, and soft ivory sheen identical across every angle; keep the clasp hardware plain, blank, unmarked metal in every shot, no tag or stamping. When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
